meta.scope: offline static; no firmware written, no flash touched, no radio contacted
meta.method: container SGMT enumeration with dual-endian load bases; long ASCII-run census per segment; anchor viability test against rate-control vocabulary; patch withheld when no anchor is viable
meta.precedent: PB-040 mutated a named ASCII anchor (UBNT_POLL_MEM_ALLOC -> OMAX_POLL_MEM_ALLOC, 4 bytes); the same method needs an RC anchor per segment

summary.blocking_reason: no SGMT segment carries a rate-control ASCII anchor, so a rename-style probe has no target

gaps: no segment has a rate-control anchor, so no per-segment probe can be built
the only long ASCII in the container is the version string, which is metadata and not code
the dual-endian load bases agree at 0x00980000, so the mapping is ambiguous and no address-based patch is defensible either
without an anchor or a proven base, any mutation offset would be fabricated
